map.由速度变化与时间求平均加速度: Average acceleration from velocity change and time
map.输入末速度 v、初速度 v₀、时间 t，求平均加速度。: Input final velocity v, initial velocity v₀, and time t to find average acceleration.
map.速度变化除以时间得平均加速度。: Average acceleration is velocity change divided by time.
map.用实验测得的速度端点值求一段过程中的平均加速度。: Use experimentally measured velocity endpoints to find the average acceleration over a process.
map.a = (10−20)/2 = −5 m/s²。即 2 秒内减速 10 m/s，: a = (10−20)/2 = −5 m/s². That is, decelerating 10 m/s in 2 s, average acceleration −5 m/s² (negative sign means deceleration).
map.初速 6 m/s，末速 30 m/s，历时 4 s: Initial speed 6 m/s, final speed 30 m/s, over 4 s
map.a=(v−v₀)/t=(30−6)/4=6.000 m/s²。若末速小于初速，结: a=(v−v₀)/t=(30−6)/4=6.000 m/s². If final speed is less than initial, the result is negative, indicating deceleration.
map.负号什么意思？: What does the negative sign mean?
map.方向与初速相反，表示减速；大小 5 m/s² 是减速度。: Opposite direction to initial velocity, indicating deceleration; magnitude 5 m/s² is the deceleration.
map.平均加速度和逐秒加速度为什么可能差很多？: Why might average acceleration differ a lot from per-second acceleration?
map.平均加速度只看首尾两个速度，抹掉了中间过程。例如汽车先猛加速再缓行，平均加速度可: Average acceleration only looks at the first and last velocities, smoothing out the middle. For example a car may accelerate hard then cruise; the average acceleration might be only 6.000 m/s² while the instant at start is far larger. For safety analysis focus on instantaneous values rather than averages.
map.平均加速度 a = (末速度 v − 初速度 v₀) ÷ 时间 t；速度变化量: Average acceleration a = (final velocity v − initial velocity v₀) ÷ time t; velocity change Δv = v − v₀; displacement in uniformly accelerated linear motion = (v + v₀) ÷ 2 × t. Validation: v, v₀ and t are guarded as non-empty numbers. Criteria: a positive a means acceleration and a negative one deceleration; the magnitude depends on both Δv and t.
